svg.title: 同在城市 3，上一站不同就有不同的下一步
svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"同在城市 3，上一站不同就有不同的下一步","steps":[{"caption":"起点状态是 (0,1)，虚拟前驱 0 不是实际城市。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"path":[1],"previous":0,"current":1,"blocked":false}},{"caption":"走到 3：上一站为 1，状态 (1,3)。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"path":[1,3],"previous":1,"current":3,"blocked":false}},{"caption":"此时不能去 4，因为 (1,3,4) 被禁止；不能把所有城市 3 状态都禁掉。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"path":[1,3],"previous":1,"current":3,"blocked":true}},{"caption":"先走到 2，得到状态 (3,2)。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"path":[1,3,2],"previous":3,"current":2,"blocked":false}},{"caption":"再回到 3：现在是不同状态 (2,3)，可以继续。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"path":[1,3,2,3],"previous":2,"current":3,"blocked":false}},{"caption":"(2,3,4) 不在禁表中，抵达 4；实际走了四条边。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"path":[1,3,2,3,4],"previous":3,"current":4,"blocked":false}}]}
